translations.web: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
translations.bsb: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.
translations.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
translations.asv: and he cried with a great voice, as a lion roareth: and when he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
